# Recursive comparable range result

A direct seed and an invariant range share one complete Comparable<? super T>
bound with the original returned formal. Frozen callers check exact low, high or
seed identity, endpoint reads, comparison order, null and wrongly typed values,
long extrema, partial writes and failure identity. Ordinary calls, reflection
and method handles use the original descriptor. All original entries and
metadata are compared through owned and imported declarations. These programs
are independently authored and contain no application data.

The inherited-owner variant calls the method through a subclass in the original
DEX, frozen direct caller, reflection and method handles. The subclass has an
observable initializer, which inherited static calls must not trigger. A sixth
wrong program deliberately initializes that facade and fails the same observer.
